_doc: Shared dials that traits feed. Every system reads the same dials; no trait carries bespoke logic. Each trait entry is 'dial' (always on) or 'dial@condition' (on when the situation contains the condition: a tag, or 'target' for the trait's own target). Totals are soft-capped per dial: cap * tanh(sum / cap), so many small traits combine meaningfully but no stack runs away. 'domain' says which side of the game reads it.

appraisal.doc: How an event feels. Conditions are matched against what the event references.

morale.doc: Own spirits; drives willingness, panic, mood.

composure.doc: Holding together under stress: suppression, fear checks, tense talks.

medicine.doc: Treating injuries, in the field and aboard.

crew_morale.doc: Effect on everyone else aboard; summed across the crew.
